findings.namedBuyers: Kyle Tomlin, Senior Director, Events - Canada, leads Canadian event operations according to his professional profile; the official 2026 page names him for booth reservations (ktomlin@icsc.com). Best organizer routing contact for the 2027 schedule and housing decision-maker. Carlos Baudett, Senior Director, Business Development, is named in ICSC’s official FAQs and is the 2026 sponsorship contact (cbaudett@icsc.com); relevant to partner/exhibitor relationships and introductions. Neither is verified as a hotel-contract signatory or accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Next located official future listing: ICSC@CANADA, September 25–30, 2027, Metro Toronto Convention Centre North Building, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. These are the venue calendar’s published event-window dates, not an article date. No organizer-published 2027 attendee schedule was located. Because the six-day span is longer than ICSC’s stated one- to three-day regional event format, whether it includes setup/teardown remains unresolved; that possibility is an inference, not a fact. Do not sell all six days as verified attendee activity dates. Verified activity-date fields remain null pending organizer confirmation. The 2026 edition is past, not an upcoming opportunity.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: a downtown Harbourfront city hotel is geographically appropriate for this MTCC event; resort positioning is not the relevant fit. The 157-room Radisson Blu should pursue a limited delegate, exhibitor-team, speaker or executive lodging allocation, potentially with small side meetings—not exclusive event housing or relocation of the convention. The supplied 15–109 peak-room range is a sales-fit envelope, not published event demand. Historical 2024 pre-event projection was close to 3,000 attendees, making whole-event housing unrealistic at this property; it does not establish 2027 attendance or sleeping-room needs. Meeting/reception proposals remain conditional on actual space, service and catering availability; do not assume restaurant/lounge operation.
findings.venueCommitments: The venue itself lists the 2027 event in its North Building, 255 Front Street West, Toronto, Ontario M5V 2W6: downtown Toronto proper / MTCC territory, not an out-of-town or resort venue. This is public venue-announcement evidence, not access to a signed contract. No competing hotel is named as the 2027 event venue.
findings.historicalRotation: Located timeline: October 7–9, 2024, Metro Toronto Convention Centre, Toronto; October 6–8, 2025, MTCC North Building, Toronto; October 5–7, 2026, MTCC North Building, Toronto; 2027 venue listing returns to the North Building. These demonstrate consecutive-year recurrence and Toronto retention in the researched editions, not a proven national destination rotation or a guaranteed future annual schedule. ICSC@WHISTLER is a separate event, not the next edition of ICSC@CANADA.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027: hotel provider, participating hotels, block commitments, rates, booking window and hotel RFP status remain unconfirmed; no edition-specific public hotel list was located. Historical 2026 official source: “You must be registered before booking your hotel. Upon registration, you will receive a confirmation email with the link to the booking site.” It also states: “ICSC will only contact you through onPeak, our official hotel provider.” Thus 2026 used registration-gated onPeak housing, not demonstrated direct open hotel sourcing. Every hotel named in the retrieved 2026 public housing section: none; the underlying gated inventory was not available. This is not evidence that there were no contracted hotels. No 2024/2025 hotel list was verified, and the 2026 provider must not automatically be carried into 2027.
findings.organizationStructure: ICSC describes itself as a worldwide member network and business association for the marketplaces industry and is the event organizer. MTCC is the venue. onPeak is the official hotel provider evidenced for 2026 only. No separate PCO or DMC was identified in the retrieved edition materials; none should be inferred.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2026 official housing was routed through onPeak; this creates a channel-access question, not proof that 2027 lodging is committed elsewhere. No incumbent hotel names, hotel sell-outs, unmet sleeping-room demand, peak rooms or room nights were verified. The 2026 trade report describes the dealmaking floor as “completely sold out” and off-site receptions at TIFF Lightbox and Cactus Club on Adelaide Street; these evidence exhibition capacity and external networking activity only, not hotel overflow or available reception business.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Kyle Tomlin first: request the attendee-facing 2027 dates within September 25–30, the housing lead/provider, contracted hotel list and whether any hotel-participation window remains. Offer a conditional, limited room allocation and executive/exhibitor lodging capability using the supplied property specification; do not quote an invented room requirement. Use Carlos Baudett for a relevant exhibitor/partner introduction, not as a presumed room-block buyer. Route any official inventory discussion through the housing party ICSC confirms. Verify hotel catering and meeting services before proposing a reception. Keep qualification provisional until dates and sales access are resolved.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 16, 2026, the October 5–7, 2026 edition has ended and is not actionable for stays. The venue-listed 2027 edition is within the requested horizon, but there is no verified open hotel RFP, available block allocation or public housing supplier application. Accessibility is relationship-led and conditional; neither a cold open sourcing opportunity nor a known closed hotel allocation can be asserted.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Toronto/MTCC editions make early organizer and housing-channel relationship development commercially plausible. Ask whether 2027 housing has been assigned and whether a small Harbourfront allocation can join the official program; if not, seek permission and appropriate routes to exhibitor/VIP subgroup lodging. No evidence currently establishes displaced delegates, open inventory or a future venue rotation. A future block or side-event win is a strategy, not confirmed demand.
